evidence: Carries the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and modifies hashing behavior specifically to optimize the in-memory UTXO cache (`CCoinsMap`) during IBD and AssumeUTXO loading.
rationale: Provides a modest 2% to 3% speedup to IBD/reindex and ~11% during AssumeUTXO loading, traded against higher memory usage per cache node. Benchmarks demonstrate reduced SipHash recomputation in `CCoinsMap`, but the optimization relies on implementation-defined `libstdc++` behavior and is reasonably deferrable.
